=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8600-8606 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The REVALIDATE_REQUESTED jq filter uses unanchored contains() to detect state-comment boundaries, so prose that merely mentions ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1/V2 can be misclassified as the latest state comment.
  WHY: All six reviewers flagged the same root cause; the filter can advance $last_state_idx past a valid /revalidate command, causing it to be ignored.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8648-8654 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The JUDGE_RESUME_BODY jq filter uses unanchored contains() to detect state-comment boundaries, so prose that merely mentions ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1/V2 can be misclassified as the latest state comment.
  WHY: All six reviewers flagged the same root cause; the filter can advance $last_state_idx past a valid /judge_resume command, causing it to be ignored.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8603 and 8651 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The jq filters at both locations use contains("ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1") / contains("ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V2") to identify the latest state comment instead of anchored prefix matching.
  WHY: A non-state comment mentioning the marker strings can advance $last_state_idx and cause /revalidate or /judge_resume commands to be silently ignored.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8603 and 8651 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The /revalidate and /judge_resume jq filters use contains(...) to identify state comment boundaries, inconsistent with the anchored startswith() pattern used elsewhere in the file.
  WHY: A non-state comment that merely mentions the marker string can shift $last_state_idx forward and suppress valid operator commands.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~8600 (REVALIDATE_REQUESTED jq filter) and ~8648 (JUDGE_RESUME_BODY jq filter) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The jq filters use contains("ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1") and contains("ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V2") to identify state comment boundaries when calculating $last_state_idx.
  WHY: A prose comment mentioning these markers can be treated as a state snapshot boundary and cause /revalidate or /judge_resume commands posted after the real snapshot to be ignored.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8603 and 8651 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Both jq filters identify the most recent state comment boundary using contains("ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1") or contains("ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V2"), which matches the marker substring anywhere in a comment body.
  WHY: This can advance $last_state_idx past a legitimate operator command, causing /revalidate or /judge_resume comments to be filtered out and leaving the project stuck.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8600-8606 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: jq filter uses contains() on body for state boundary detection, matching any substring occurrence rather than anchored header.
  WHY: Operator comment like "update ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V2 handling" can falsely advance $last_state_idx and ignore subsequent /revalidate commands.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8648-8654 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Same unanchored contains() filter as REVALIDATE_REQUESTED.
  WHY: Prose mention of markers in comment can shift $last_state_idx and suppress /judge_resume commands after the latest real state snapshot.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8603 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The REVALIDATE_REQUESTED jq filter uses contains() to identify state-comment boundaries, matching any occurrence of the marker strings anywhere in a comment body.
  WHY: A prose comment can be incorrectly treated as a state snapshot boundary, shifting $last_state_idx forward and causing valid /revalidate commands to be ignored.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8651 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The JUDGE_RESUME_BODY jq filter has the same contains() vulnerability.
  WHY: A prose comment mentioning the state marker can suppress /judge_resume commands that should be processed.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
